# Draft:Badru Michael Oluwarotimi

Badru Michael Oluwarotimi is a Nigerian philosopher, metaphysical theorist, and independent researcher. He is best known as the founder of the Spiritualectics framework—an original philosophical system integrating metaphysics, behavioral science, and energy modeling.
Early life and education
Badru Michael Oluwarotimi earned his Bachelor of Science in Botany from Lagos State University in 2023. His early academic work merged ecological principles with energetic philosophy, laying the foundation for what would later become the Spiritualectics doctrine.
Theories and Contributions
Spiritualectics
Spiritualectics is a metaphysical and philosophical system authored by Oluwarotimi. It synthesizes ancient spiritual insights, energy field mapping, and feedback theory to explore awareness, reincarnation, karmic cycles, and death prediction.
Terminal Manner Doctrine (TMD)
This model predicts patterns and timing surrounding human death based on energetic decay and resonance mapping.
Quantifiable Energy-Aura Scale (QEAS)
QEAS is a diagnostic model for scoring a person’s energetic condition based on behavioral, emotional, and karmic states.
Spiritualectic Suicide Prediction Matrix (SSPM)
SSPM is a predictive tool to assess suicide risk by evaluating spiritual depletion and energetic dissonance.
Eλ Gene Doctrine
This theory proposes the existence of a metaphysical energy gene (“Eλ”) that determines spiritual immunity or susceptibility to parasitic entities.
Free Will Theory of Constraint
Oluwarotimi’s Free Will Theory posits that all will is exercised under embedded environmental and karmic constraints, but can be transcended through awareness and energetic clarity.
Law of Awareness-Encoded Immunity
This doctrine suggests that spiritual parasitism can only occur through unconscious repetition—and that awareness acts as a metaphysical firewall that breaks parasitic cycles.
